errors.text: The proposed Al-induced B2 network does not reconstruct the Cr-induced Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves-phase intervention.

The cited B2 evidence indicates that a continuous ordered B2 phase promotes brittle behavior, whereas ductility improves when B2 is discrete within a continuous BCC matrix; it therefore does not support making B2 the reticulated continuous network.
The predicted density increase is physically implausible for minor Al addition to this dense refractory alloy; Al should generally reduce density.
The stated target of fracture strain greater than 5% does not establish improvement over the actual baseline fracture strain of approximately 11.6%.

The falsification experiment does not cleanly distinguish solid-solution hardening from phase-structure strengthening because it lacks a composition-matched, phase-suppressed control and lattice-parameter or solute-strain measurements.
